content.text: Finally, let me create a detailed manifest showing the complete output:

input.command: cd /mnt/user-data/outputs && ls -lh && echo -e "\n=== FILE MANIFEST ===" && wc -l * && echo -e "\n=== CHECKSUM FILE INFO ===" && python3 -c "import json; c=json.load(open('checksums.json')); print(f'Source rows: {len(c[\"source_rows\"])}'); print(f'Standardized rows: {len(c[\"standardized_rows\"])}'); print(f'Cell checksums tracked: {len(c[\"cell_checksums\"])} rows')"
input.description: Generate a manifest of all output files
